table.name: TLGNC_POOL
table.description: Carriers (=Transporteure) are grouped into regional units, so-called Pools. A pool can only consist of Truck OR Rail carriers, characterized by sap_trsp_mode_cd. A carrier itself does not have such an attribute, the membership in such a pool is sufficient for Logon to accept a carrier as a rail or a truck carrier. The pools 'Rail Standard Gauge' and 'Rail Narrow Gauge' are actually rather artificial; there are very few SAP vendors which are SBB or RhB (but unfortunately they cannot be recognized by looking at tlgns_sap_vendor).

column.name: SAP_TRSP_MODE_CD
column.description: Transportation mode as distinguished by SAP: 10=Truck, 50=Train, (00=Pickup/Selbstabholer, but irrelevant here). When creating an order the possible pools directly depend on this field, it must be equal to the sap_trsp_mode_cd of the chosen delivery type (tlgnr_delivery_type_bs). I.e. 'Rail direct' and 'Bimodal Rail-Part' require the use of a rail pool.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
